Κνίδος.long: Cnidus, a town on the coast of Caria (south-west Asia Minor) near the island of Cos.
Κνίδος.sd: Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor
Κνίδος.as:
Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ,
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Ac 27:7.†

κνήθομαι.long: I rub, tickle, scratch; pass: I itch.
κνήθομαι.sd: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle
κνήθομαι.as:
* κνήθω
(late form of κνάω),
1.to scratch.
2.to tickle; pass., to itch: II Ti 4:3.†
